record.original_question: For every real number x ≥ 1/4, prove the Simic two-sided logarithmic inequality: ln((12x^2 + 6x + 1 - 1/(60x^2 + 2))/(12x^2 - 6x + 1 - 1/(60x^2 + 2))) < 1/x < ln((12x^2 + 6x + 1 - 1/(60x^2 + 1))/(12x^2 - 6x + 1 - 1/(60x^2 + 1))).

        
     ln                    60x2 + 2  < 1 < ln                  60x2 + 1  .                    (3.24)
                               1                                   1     

The main object of this paper is to solve several open problems proposed by Zhang
      and Xu, Bencze, and Simić.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Prove that for every real number $x \geq 1/4$ the following two-sided inequality holds:
\[
\ln\!\left(\frac{12x^2 + 6x + 1 - \dfrac{1}{60x^2 + 2}}{12x^2 - 6x + 1 - \dfrac{1}{60x^2 + 2}}\right) \;<\; \frac{1}{x} \;<\; \ln\!\left(\frac{12x^2 + 6x + 1 - \dfrac{1}{60x^2 + 1}}{12x^2 - 6x + 1 - \dfrac{1}{60x^2 + 1}}\right).
\]
artifact.status_search_result: The inequality was posed as an open problem by Simić and has been resolved; a published solution establishes both sides of the inequality for all x ≥ 1/4.

status_evidence.claim: The Simić logarithmic inequality is proved in this work.
